newsitem.title: USA: Canyon Resources says drilling ups reserves.
newsitem.headline: Canyon Resources says drilling ups reserves.

text.p: Canyon Resources Corp said Tuesday recent drilling has increased mineable reserves at the Briggs Mine by 318,700 ounces, representing a 49 percent increase of the initial Briggs reserve.
The company said the increase means there is a total mineable reserve at Briggs of 971,700 ounces of gold.
Canyon also said it has drilled four holes into a new discovery at Pleasant Canyon, nine miles north of Briggs within its 17,000-acre claim block in the Panamint range of southeastern California.
